name: us-hiring-your-children-and-accountable-plans
description: How a US business owner can pay their own child a reasonable wage in 2026 (social security and Medicare exemption under 18 and FUTA exemption under 21 only for a parent's sole proprietorship, a parents-only partnership or a parent's disregarded single-member LLC, never a corporation or S corporation; the child's dependent standard deduction of the greater of $1,350 or earned income plus $450, capped at $16,100; the kiddie tax does not reach wages) and reimburse owners and employees tax-free through an accountable plan (three requirements, 60 and 120 day safe harbours, the two 2026 business mileage rates of 72.5 and 76 cents, the per diem limit for owners of more than 10%). Trigger on "hire my kids", "pay my children", "family employee", "accountable plan", "reimburse S corp owner", "mileage reimbursement". Federal only.
